title: Version Snapshot System
description: Implement full content snapshot version history for chapters. Auto-save snapshots throttled to 1 per 5 minutes, manual named snapshots, 50 per chapter retention, compressed storage.
action: Create desktop/src/services/versionService.ts with snapshot CRUD, auto-save throttling, retention enforcement, and text diff generation. Store snapshots as compressed JSON files in version directory.

convergence.verification: Snapshots created on content change (throttled), manual snapshots supported, retention policy enforced, diff between two snapshots produces readable output
convergence.definition_of_done: Auto-save creates snapshots (max 1 per 5 min), manual snapshots with names, 50 per chapter cap, compressed storage, text diff between versions

files.change: New service with createSnapshot, listSnapshots, getSnapshot, restoreSnapshot, diffSnapshots, enforceRetentionPolicy
Add auto-save snapshot trigger after debounced save, throttled to 1 per 5 minutes

implementation: 2. Define Snapshot type: { id, chapterId, timestamp, label (optional), contentHash, textContent, fileSize }

3. Implement createSnapshot(projectId, chapterId, content, label?): write TipTap JSON to 'projects/{projectId}/chapters/{chapterId}/versions/{timestamp}.json', store metadata in 'projects/{projectId}/chapters/{chapterId}/versions/index.json'
4. Implement listSnapshots(projectId, chapterId): read version index, return sorted by timestamp DESC
5. Implement getSnapshot(projectId, chapterId, snapshotId): read snapshot file
6. Implement restoreSnapshot(projectId, chapterId, snapshotId): get snapshot content, write as current chapter content via projectFileService
7. Implement diffSnapshots(projectId, chapterId, fromId, toId): load both, extract textContent, run Myers diff, return diff result
8. Implement enforceRetentionPolicy(projectId, chapterId): if snapshots > 50, delete oldest (keeping named snapshots)
9. Implement shouldAutoSave(lastSnapshotTime): return true if Date.now() - lastSnapshotTime > 5 * 60 * 1000
10. Add auto-save trigger in DocumentEditor: after debounced save, check shouldAutoSave, call createSnapshot if true
test: Unit tests: create/list/get snapshots, retention policy enforcement, diff generation. Integration: auto-save throttle prevents duplicate snapshots within 5 min window
reference: L-004 (Full Content Snapshots), F-003 (gzip compression guidance)
rationale: Version history is a top user request and provides safety net for writers experimenting with content changes
risks: Snapshot file size growth — mitigated by retention policy
Compression performance — start with uncompressed JSON, add gzip optimization if needed
